clips.vo: Zephyr Kreye. Six foot five, two hundred twenty pounds. Quarterback, Anna High School, class of twenty twenty-seven.

clips.headline: 67-yard touchdown pass vs Colleyville Heritage
clips.note: 720p pull from Hudl, upscaled; keeps Hudl's own '#17 ZEPHYR KREYE' card rather than stacking a second label

clips.headline: Behind-the-QB cam: escapes, deep ball in stride — about a 55-yard gain
clips.note: end-zone angle behind the offense; snap ~0:13.5, scramble right, deep shot caught on the run, run down to the opponent ~30
clips.vo: Backed up deep. Kreye rolls out, sets his feet, and launches. Caught in stride at midfield and gone — fifty-five yards.

clips.headline: Strike on the right hash — catch and run from midfield to the 25
clips.note: snap ~0:42.5, completion ~0:44.3 near the 40, tackled ~0:48.3 around the 25; high sideline cam
clips.vo: Kreye takes the snap at midfield, quick drop, ball out to the right hash. Catch, turn upfield, and he's across the thirty before they bring him down.

clips.headline: Off-platform throw on the move — completion at the 50
clips.note: moves to his non-throwing side, keeps his eyes up, releases at 0:44.1
clips.vo: Edge comes free. Kreye slides left, throws across his body, on the money at the fifty.

clips.headline: 29-yard touchdown pass
clips.note: confirmed by the Hudl card in-clip and the stadium ribbon board
clips.vo: First and ten at the twenty-nine. Kreye works right and finds number one in the flat. He's got blockers. Pylon. Touchdown.

clips.headline: 40-yard touchdown pass vs Brock
clips.note: 720p pull from Hudl, upscaled; keeps Hudl's own '#17 ZEPHYR KREYE' card rather than stacking a second label

clips.headline: Behind-the-QB cam: clean pocket, on-time ball over the middle
clips.note: same end-zone camera; snap ~0:26.7, completion ~0:29.7 for roughly twenty yards
clips.vo: Clean pocket. Ball out on time, over the middle. Twenty yards.

clips.headline: Deep ball down the boundary — about 30 yards to #2
clips.vo: Kreye takes his shot down the right boundary. Number two runs under it. Thirty yards, down inside the twenty.
